content.summary: Moleculin Biotech (MBRX) announced the pricing of a public offering consisting of 16,080,000 shares of common stock and Series E warrants to purchase up to 48,240,000 shares of its common stock, at a combined public offering price per share of common stock and accompanying Series E warrants of 37c.
